So Ziggy/Izzy.....
On Weds I collected my TNR from Zikkos and Andri 🤮🤮... showed me this stray kitten that had been brought in a couple of weeks ago by a passerby... the kitten was well now, there were no broken bones but some neurological damage which meant she had to have a lump aspirated on her forehead but the woman didn't want to keep it herself so was going to put it back on the street. Andri didnt want this to happen so was asking around if anyone could take her.... i sent E,B and A the video of her and they said yes she could come to FOLC... in the video i asked again if she was healthy and needed any more treatment... no she's fine i was told.... so i collected her Thurs.... yesterday when we were taking photos Claire noticed a lump on her forehead... i wrote immediately to Andri with photos from Weds and Fri... i heard nothing.
Anyway i then had 2 choices... to take her back to Zikkos where a) if Zikkos paid the absolute minimum would be done or b) i would pay and be charged a massive amount for unnecessary work... so i chose option 2 and took her to V3ts accepting i would pay the bill but at least i would trust what they told me and the work done... they took 2 Xrays and although i was with Dr Elena she showed them to Dr Kyriakos who thinks its not a car crash but a bite/infection as there are no indications of any broken bones.. just "fluid" on her forehead... so we've given her strong antibiotics (Convenia) plus Zodon once a day to return in a week....
So when/if she's well she will revert to FoLC but at the moment she's mine...
When i got a response from Zikkos it was "Ok when u come in bring her so we can check her out.She looks well !!" As a 9wk old kitten with a lump the size of a walnut on her head does not "look well" i was doubley glad i had taken her elsewhere....
